title: Page 7
content_zh:
一样是陆家千金，一样是陆忠贤的女儿，可陆诗妍一出生坐稳了陆家大小姐的位置，且注定是靳家的准媳妇，而她的女儿什么都没有，什么都不是。

虽说这两年也有不少安阳的富户托人登门提亲，可比起靳家，那真是天壤之别，为了抢走陆诗妍的一切，她想尽办法推掉了那些亲事，就是为了今天。

「诗妍，别怪我，人不为己，天诛地灭，我是个母亲，为了我的女儿，就算让我下阿鼻地狱，我都愿意。」赵氏对着昏迷的陆诗妍说道，「反正你现在这样要死不活的活着也没有意义，我就送你上路吧！」说完，她抬起双手对着她的颈子伸去。

突地，她想到这样掐陆诗妍的脖子会留下印子，她思绪一转，抓起被子朝陆诗妍的面上一蒙。

就在此时，一直昏迷不醒的陆诗妍身子一震，一把抓住赵氏的手。

「啊！」赵氏纵有天大胆子，也吓得惊呼出声。

陆诗妍一手掀掉覆在面上的被子，一手攫住赵氏的手，瞪着面露惊恐的赵氏。

「你、你……」赵氏惊慌失措。

「母亲，」陆诗妍神情凝沉地问道：「为什么？」

「你……你醒了？」赵氏倒抽一口气。「你是什么时候……」

「在母亲跟诗媚杀了向姑娘的时候，我就醒了。」陆诗妍回道。

赵氏陡地一震。「你怎么……怎么会……」

赵氏难以相信她竟会知道向丽平的事，她不是一直在安阳昏迷着吗？为什么会知道发生在景安的事情？难道是靳雪鸿告诉她的？若是如此，不就表示靳雪鸿也知晓此事？

不不不，不可能，没人知道是她将向丽平沉入春溪，没人知道是她动了手脚让马车失事，没人知道！

「母亲，我视你如亲娘，为什么你要如此对我？」陆诗妍悲愤低喊，「您还将诗媚也拖下了水，让她做出伤天害理之事，行至发疯的田地，身为娘亲的您，于心何忍？」

赵氏挣开了她的手，倒退两步，惊怒地瞪着已从床上坐起的她。「你什么都道了？」

尽管内心充满疑惑，无法理解陆诗妍是如何知道这些秘密，也不知道陆诗妍是何时苏醒，又是如何苏醒，但此时此刻，她也没有时间深究，她只晓得一件事，陆诗妍更留不得了！

「你不该活着、不该醒来，有你就没有诗媚，你非死不可。」赵氏眼底迸射出可怕又疯狂的杀意。

「母亲，事到如今，您还不悔悟吗？」

赵氏哼哼冷笑，「十几年了，我走到今日，是该有个了结了。」说罢，她突然一个箭步冲上去，掐住陆诗妍的脖子。

陆诗妍抓着她的手反抗着。「母亲，别一错再错了！」

赵氏眼中爬满了红丝，决心要置她于死地，一边咒骂道：「你不该活着！你怎么不死？你怎么不随着老马跟碧水一起死？可恶的丫头！你快去死！」

忽地，一双大手捉住赵氏肩膀，赵氏都还来不及反应，身子便被往后拉倒。

她一个踉跄跌坐在地，忍不住哀叫一声。这一跤跌得不轻，她一时竟起不来。猛回神，她发现眼前站了一个人，她的视线自那人的双脚往上快速的移动，然后猛然一惊。

此时，站在她面前的正是靳雪鸿，他唇角微勾，但直视着她的眼神却是冷厉又让人惊惧。

「你……」太多突发的状况让赵氏慌了。

「赵氏，」靳雪鸿冷然一笑，「夜路走多了，总会撞鬼的。」

她面露惊恐。「什……这、这是……」

「你所有恶行我都知晓了。」靳雪鸿目光一凝。「很遗憾，你这颗埋了十多年的邪恶种子，终究无法开花结果。」

闻言，赵氏惊觉大势已去。「难道一切都是你……」

「没错。」靳雪鸿神情冷肃，语气严厉，「这是一个局，多行不义必自毙，你是咎由自取！」

「你、你们……」赵氏看着他，再看着陆诗妍，仿佛发狂地说。「你们想弄死我吗？你们……你们……」

就在这时，有另一道身影自夹间里慢慢走出——

第10章(1)

一直隐身在夹间里的陆忠贤心如刀割，亦心痛如绞。

要不是亲耳听见赵氏所言，他实在无法全然相信先前靳雪鸿跟他说的那些事。今早，靳雪鸿说是想在安阳开铺子，请他为他物色几家店面，他不疑有他，便跟着靳雪鸿出门了。

路上，靳雪鸿告诉他，他以为仍在昏迷的女儿诗妍已经趋醒，还说诗妍搭乘的马车会发生意外全是人为，当他问及为何诗妍已苏醒，却还要佯装昏迷时，靳雪鸿却说只要他今晩借故不与赵氏同床，前往诗妍房间躲藏，就能知道真相。

为着靳雪鸿口中的真相，陆忠贤以到碧山寺与住持秉烛夜谈为由，制造不在府内的假象。

黄昏时，他从正门离开，入夜后，再乔装由后院小门进到府内，前来长女的小院，并见到经趋醒的女儿。

当他询问女儿细节时，她欲言又止，似有难言之隐，最后只这么说道——一

爹，女儿实在不知从何说起，但若今晚蛇出洞了，您必会看见真相。

诗妍的回答就跟靳雪鸿一样充满玄机，为了尽快得到答案，他暗自期盺着女儿口中所谓的蛇出洞。

他等了又等，终于等到了蛇出洞，而让他难以置信的是，这条蛇竟是他一直以来疼爱及信任的继室。

在夹间里听见赵氏跟诗妍的对话，一字一句都像是利刃般插进他的心窝。他以为替一出生就没有母亲疼爱的诗妍找了个视她如己出的继母，却没想到这个继母处心积虑的想夺走她的一切，包括她的性命。

他太震惊，而且与其说是愤怒，其实更多的是痛心和失望。

这些天，陆诗媚病了，府里有一些奇奇怪怪的传言，关于女鬼什么的，他总认为是无稽之谈，还要赵氏立即找大夫为陆诗媚看病。

没想到陆诗媚的病，全是因为赵氏的恶毒而导致，身为母亲的她，居然将女儿往地狱里推。

他的血液像是停止流动了，他的身体好冷好冷。

陆忠贤颤抖着声音道：「赵氏，你好狠毒的心！」

一见丈夫从夹间里走出来，赵氏脸色一白，惊恐又心虚。「老、老爷……」

「别叫我！」陆忠贤恨恨地瞪着她，痛心疾首。「你这毒妇！」

「老爷，我……」

陆忠贤走上前，颤抖的手指向她。「我待你不薄啊，你为何如此狠毒，竟想置诗妍于死地？她自懂事以来就只有你一个娘，亦真心疼爱异母妹妹，可你因为私心，不只自小灌输诗媚错误的观念，让她将诗妍视如仇人，还拉着诗媚做了这么多的坏事，你、你的心让狗给吃了吗？」

「老爷……」赵氏百莫辩，只能一次一次的唤着老爷。

「你什么都不必说了，我都听见了。」陆忠贤实在太痛心，一个晕眩，踉跄了两步。

「世叔……」靳雪鸿急忙上前扶住他，神情冷峻地睨着赵氏。「赵氏，我已经找到当初帮你在马车上动手脚的工匠，也就是你那个在杨记做事的远房外甥李一春，而他也经认罪，你罪证确凿。」

「一切都是你……」赵氏眼底燃烧着怒火。「不，是你们！是你跟诗妍那丫头设计我！」说着，她突然自地上一挺而起，冲向了陆诗妍，一把掐住陆诗妍的脖子，疯了似的咆哮道：「我杀了你！我杀了你！」

靳雪鸿见状，立刻大步向前，一把抓住了几近疯狂的赵氏，然后一个振臂将她摔在地上。
content_en:
Both are the daughter of the Lu family, and the same are the daughters of Lu Zhongxian. However, Lu Shiyan has secured her position as the eldest lady of the Lu family since she was born, and is destined to be the soon-to-be daughter-in-law of the Jin family. However, her daughter has nothing and is nothing.

Although many rich people from Anyang have come to propose marriage in the past two years, it is really different from the Jin family. In order to steal everything from Lu Shiyan, she tried her best to turn down those marriages, just for today.

"Shiyan, don't blame me. If you don't care for yourself, you will be destroyed. I am a mother. For my daughter, even if I am sent to Abi Hell, I am willing to do so." Zhao said to the unconscious Lu Shiyan, "Anyway, there is no point in living like this. I will send you on your way!" After saying that, she raised her hands and stretched out towards her neck.

Suddenly, she thought that pinching Lu Shiyan's neck like this would leave a mark. Her thoughts changed, she grabbed the quilt and covered Lu Shiyan's face.

At this moment, Lu Shiyan, who had been unconscious all this time, trembled and grabbed Zhao's hand.

"Ah!" Even if Mrs. Zhao was brave enough, she would still exclaim in fright.

Lu Shiyan lifted off the quilt covering her face with one hand, grabbed Zhao's hand with the other, and stared at the frightened Zhao.

"You, you..." Zhao was panicked.

"Mother," Lu Shiyan asked solemnly, "Why?"

"You...you're awake?" Zhao took a breath."When did you..."

"I woke up when my mother and Shi Mei killed Miss Xiang." Lu Shiyan replied.

Zhao was shocked."How...how could you..."

Mrs. Zhao couldn't believe that she actually knew about Xiang Liping. Wasn't she unconscious in Anyang?Why do you know what happened in Jing'an?Could it be that Jin Xuehong told her?If so, doesn't it mean that Jin Xuehong also knows about this?

No, no, no, it's impossible. No one knows that she will sink Xiang Liping into the spring stream. No one knows that she tampered with the carriage and caused the carriage to crash. No one knows!

"Mother, I treat you like my own mother, why do you do this to me?" Lu Shiyan shouted in grief and anger, "You also dragged Shimei into the water, making her do evil things and drive her crazy. As a mother, how can you bear it?"

Mrs. Zhao broke away from her hand, took two steps back, and stared at her in shock and anger as she sat up from the bed."Did you know everything?"

Although she was full of doubts in her heart and couldn't understand how Lu Shiyan knew these secrets, and she didn't know when and how Lu Shiyan woke up, but at this moment, she had no time to delve into it. She only knew one thing, and Lu Shiyan couldn't stay!

"You shouldn't be alive, you shouldn't wake up. Without you, there would be no Shimei. You must die." Zhao's eyes burst out with terrifying and crazy killing intent.

"Mother, don't you regret it now?"

Mrs. Zhao snorted and sneered, "After more than ten years, I have come to this day and it's time for me to come to an end." After saying that, she suddenly rushed forward and grabbed Lu Shiyan's neck.

Lu Shiyan grabbed her hand and resisted."Mother, don't make the same mistake again and again!"

Zhao's eyes were filled with red threads, and she was determined to kill her, while cursing: "You shouldn't live! Why don't you die? Why don't you die with Lao Ma and Bishui? Damn girl! Go die!"

Suddenly, a pair of big hands grabbed Zhao's shoulders. Before Zhao could react, she was pulled backwards.

She stumbled and fell to the ground, unable to help but scream.The fall was so severe that she couldn't get up for a while.Suddenly coming back to her senses, she found a person standing in front of her. Her eyes quickly moved up from the person's feet, and then she was suddenly startled.

At this moment, it was Jin Xuehong who was standing in front of her. The corners of his lips were slightly raised, but the look he was looking directly at her was cold, stern and frightening.

"You..." Too many unexpected situations made Zhao panic.

"Ms. Zhao," Jin Xuehong smiled coldly, "if you walk too much at night, you will always encounter ghosts."

She looked horrified."Wha... this, this is..."

"I know all your evil deeds." Jin Xuehong's eyes narrowed."It's a pity that the evil seed you have buried for more than ten years cannot bear fruit after all."

Hearing this, Mrs. Zhao was shocked to realize that the situation was over."Is it all you..."

"That's right." Jin Xuehong's expression was cold and solemn, and his tone was stern, "This is a game. If you do any unjust things, you will be killed. You are the one to blame!"

"You, you..." Mrs. Zhao looked at him, then at Lu Shiyan, and said as if madly."Do you want to kill me? You...you..."

At this moment, another figure slowly walked out of the sandwich room——

Chapter 10(1)

Lu Zhongxian, who had been hiding in the sandwich room, was heartbroken and heartbroken.

If he hadn't heard what Zhao said with his own ears, he really wouldn't have been able to completely believe what Jin Xuehong told him before.This morning, Jin Xuehong said that he wanted to open a shop in Anyang and asked him to find a few stores for him. He followed Jin Xuehong out without doubting that he was there.

On the way, Jin Xuehong told him that he thought his daughter Shiyan, who was still in a coma, had woken up. He also said that the accident on the carriage Shiyan was riding was entirely man-made. When he asked why Shiyan pretended to be unconscious even though she was awake, Jin Xuehong said that as long as he made an excuse not to sleep with Zhao tonight and went to Shiyan's room to hide, he would know the truth.

For the truth told by Jin Xuehong, Lu Zhongxian went to Bishan Temple to have a night talk with the abbot Bingzhu, creating the illusion that he was not in the house.

At dusk, he left the main entrance. After nightfall, he disguised himself and entered the house through the small door in the backyard. He came to the eldest daughter's courtyard and saw his daughter who was gradually waking up.

When he asked his daughter for details, she hesitated and seemed to have something to hide. Finally, she just said this -

Dad, my daughter, I really don’t know where to start, but if the snake comes out of the hole tonight, you will definitely see the truth.

Shiyan's answer was as mysterious as Jin Xuehong's. In order to get the answer as soon as possible, he secretly waited for the so-called snake to come out of the hole as his daughter said.

He waited and waited, and finally waited until the snake came out of the hole. To his disbelief, the snake turned out to be the step-sister he had always loved and trusted.

He heard the conversation between Zhao and Shiyan in the sandwich room, and every word was like a sharp knife piercing into his heart.He thought he had found a stepmother for Shi Yan, who had no mother's love since birth, but he did not expect that this stepmother deliberately wanted to take away everything from her, including her life.

He was so shocked, and more sad and disappointed than angry.

These days, Lu Shimei was ill, and there were some strange rumors in the house. He always thought it was nonsense about female ghosts and so on, and asked Mrs. Zhao to find a doctor to see Lu Shimei immediately.

Unexpectedly, Lu Shimei's illness was all caused by Zhao's viciousness. As a mother, she actually pushed her daughter into hell.

His blood seemed to have stopped flowing, and his body felt so cold.

Lu Zhongxian said with a trembling voice: "Ms. Zhao, you have such a cruel heart!"

When she saw her husband walking out of the closet, Ms. Zhao's face turned pale, frightened and guilty."O-Master..."

"Don't call me!" Lu Zhongxian glared at her with hatred and heartache."You vicious woman!"

"Master, I..."

Lu Zhongxian stepped forward and pointed at her with trembling fingers."I'm not treating you badly. Why are you so cruel and want to kill Shiyan? She has only had you as her mother since she was sensible, and she truly loves her half-sister. But because of your selfishness, you not only instilled wrong ideas in Shimei since she was a child, making her regard Shiyan as an enemy, but you also led Shimei to do so many bad things. Have you let a dog eat your heart?"

"Master..." Zhao couldn't argue and could only call the master again and again.

"You don't have to say anything, I heard everything." Lu Zhongxian was so sad that he felt dizzy and staggered two steps.

"Uncle Shi..." Jin Xuehong hurriedly stepped forward to support him, looking at Zhao sternly."Ms. Zhao, I have found the craftsman who helped you tamper with the carriage, that is, your distant nephew Li Yichun who works at Yangji, and he has also confessed. The evidence of your guilt is conclusive."

"It's all your fault..." Zhao's eyes were burning with anger."No, it's you! It's you and that girl Shiyan who set me up!" As she said that, she suddenly stood up from the ground, rushed towards Lu Shiyan, grabbed Lu Shiyan's neck, and roared like crazy: "I'll kill you! I'll kill you!"

Upon seeing this, Jin Xuehong immediately strode forward, grabbed the almost crazy Zhao, and then raised her arms and threw her to the ground.
